title: Added shortcut does not always work
body:
### Tested versions

I came across this problem in Godot 4.6 (the .NET version) in Windows 11 and Fedora 43.
I came across this problem in Godot 4.6, 4.5.1, 4.4.1, 4.3, 4.2.2, 4.1.4 and 4.0.4 (the standart versions) in Windows 11.
I came across this problem partially in Godot 3.6.2 (the standart version) in Windows 11.


### System information

Windows 11 and Fedora 43, Godot standart and .NET version

### Issue description

As you know, the Godot editor shortcut Ctrl + A opens the "Add Child Node" window and I wanted to use the Shift + A shortcut for the same functionality. So, I added (not replaced, added) the Shift + A shortcut in the Editor Settings > Shortcuts window.

The problem is, when I select a Node in the Scene Tree or select the Scene Tree and do not move my cursor from the Scene Tree, the Shift + A shortcut does not work but Ctrl + A shortcut does work. When I move my cursor to the game editor window, the Shift + A shortcut works (because it autofocuses to the game editor window). Also, if I do not select anything from the Scene Tree and have my cursor at the Scene Tree, the Shift + A shortcut works. (Ctrl + A shortcut works in all of these cases.)

So, the case of Shift + A shortcut that I added not working occurs when I select a Node in the Scene Tree or select the Scene Tree and not move the cursor from the Scene Tree.

Also, I tested this with making the Shift + A shortcut as Keycode, Physical Keycode and Key Label. The outcome did not change.

I had this problem in Godot 4.6 (the .NET version) both in Linux and Windows. (I use Fedora 43 and Windows 11)

I have seen this forum post that has a similar problem which has been tested in Godot 4.3 Beta 1: https://forum.godotengine.org/t/shortcut-modification-does-not-always-work/68661

So, I tested this "Shift + A not working" case in the versions 4.6, 4.5.1, 4.4.1, 4.3, 4.2.2, 4.1.4 and 4.0.4 (the standart versions) in Windows 11 and all of them had the same problem.
(When I tested in these versions, I opened a new project for every version and I made the Shift + A shortcut as Keycode because Ctrl + A shortcut is also in Keycode.)

When I tested this in 3.6.2, I needed to replace the shortcut and I did. When I select a Node in the Scene Tree and do not move my cursor from the Scene Tree, the Shift + A shortcut does not work but when I select the Scene Tree and do not move my cursor from the Scene Tree, the Shift + A shortcut does work.


### Steps to reproduce

I add the Shift + A shortcut in the Editor Settings > Shortcuts window.

Select a Node in the Scene Tree or select the Scene Tree and do not move the cursor from the Scene Tree, the Shift + A shortcut does not work but Ctrl + A shortcut does work.

Move the cursor to the game editor window, the Shift + A shortcut works.

Do not select anything from the Scene Tree and have the cursor at the Scene Tree, the Shift + A shortcut works.

[test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24974080/test.zip)
